authorization: After the 13 November release the owner said "do what you can on your side for now": the About page copy (#104) and the slow text service were named.

Shown four decisions (release the two merged fixes; automatic images charged without a price confirmation; credits lost when a session ends 30 days after it began; whether to serve the imported World English Bible for every default-translation page), the owner answered "You make the calls and continue".

Calls made on that answer: release; automatic images off by default for guests (#429); guest sessions 60 days idle and 365 days at most with a 7-day admin window (#428); the imported text stays a stand-in only (no change).
Not covered and not done: paid seeding, which needs an OpenRouter top-up and a dollar figure from the owner.

release.reviewFindings: Sol reviewed each change (3, 1, 2, 2 and 2 rounds). #426: seven claims in the first draft of the About copy were false or incomplete, among them that a price is always shown first (automatic and bulk images have no per-image confirmation) and that credits in an ended session cannot be recovered. #428: the admin expiry job stopped after one batch; the start-up check still held the old defaults. #429: the switch could be turned on while its price was not showing. #430: the newer package raises the guest token refresh leeway from 2 to 10 seconds, which in a session cookie's last seconds would make the client ask for tokens until the rate limit signed the guest out; the old value is now set explicitly. CodeRabbit on #427: a guide sentence about which text feeds images, and a missing set-up step in the README's test commands. All fixed before merge. One finding on #428 was declined and is listed as a follow-up.

steps.why: #428 was already merged but its Convex push was blocked (see convexCli), so the commit before it was released on its own.

steps.order: Convex first, then Vercel, by hand.
steps.betweenTheTwo: With the new Convex functions and the previous frontend, health was ok.

deploy.convexCli: On 14 November `convex deploy --dry-run` with the installed convex 1.31.2 stopped at "Uploading functions" with `Unexpected Error … childComponents[0].args: Required`; the same dry run had passed on 13 November. Dry runs with 1.32.0, 1.36.0 and 1.38.0 failed the same way; 1.39.1 and later passed. 1.39.1 to 1.41.0 depend on a ws inside high-severity advisory ranges, so #430 raised the package to 1.42.3. Nothing was pushed with a CLI newer than the installed package.

aboutPage: A session ends after 60 days without use and, at the latest, a year after it began.
If you turn on “Generate automatically” in the image settings, a verse that has no image in your chosen style is illustrated when you open it, as long as you have enough credits.

notExercised: A funded guest accepting an image price, a paid chat turn and a payment credited with the tab closed are still unproven in production; they need one real purchase.
An admin login after the release, which sets the first 7-day window.
The settings switch and the empty-verse state were not looked at in a browser; they are covered by component tests.
The reader's stand-in during a real outage of the text service; it was checked on a local build with the service blocked and hanging.
followUps: Reference lookup has no stand-in, so Romans 16:26–27 cannot be drawn in the default translation.
Paid requests renew the cookie but only /api/session renews the stored session row's 90-day deadline (declined on #428 as too rare).
Bulk generation shows an estimated total and no per-image confirmation.
Move convex from 1.42.3 to the current release with time to watch it.
Committed convex/_generated/api.d.ts differs from what the CLI writes on a push; it was restored after the push, as on 13 November.

rollback.vercel: Promote dpl_8qJPzYrYH2q9p1ugxfkBVS496PzP (before #428 and #430) or dpl_4dtHFYTkZvJDpwSpgXVWsSzvyYSA (the 13 November release). Promoting either while Convex keeps the admin window is safe: the window only shortens owner access.
rollback.convex: No older CLI can push. To go back, revert on main and push with the installed 1.42.3 CLI. The new field and index are additive.
rollback.sessions: Reverting #428 restores the 7-day and 30-day limits at once, since they are checked on every request.
